## Task
Do A and B name the same business concept (the same real-world thing, so the classes model one concept under different names)? Concepts that merely share attributes such as an id or a date are not the same.

### A
concept: Booking
where: BookingRepository (uses), src/persistence/bookingRepository.ts, component persistence

=====SOURCE-END=====

response.rationale: Booking is stored in its own map in BookingRepository ("private readonly bookings = new Map<string, Booking>();") and is looked up per session (SessionService -> BookingRepository.findBySession). Club bookings come from a separate ClubBookingRepository (SessionService -> ClubBookingRepository.findByDate) and are filtered by overlapping time ranges (".filter((c) => c.start < session.end && session.start < c.end);"). This suggests a club booking reserves a block of time that can reduce session availability, rather than being a customer's place in a session. Only Booking appears in the payment and expiry flows (BookingService.handlePaymentResult, releaseExpired). They have separate repositories, lookups and lifecycles, so they are related but distinct concepts.
